result.title: Valid Early Detection of Memorization in Diffusion Models
result.comment: Extended version of a 4-page paper accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on E-Values: From Statistics to ML. 13 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables
result.summary: Diffusion models can sometimes reproduce examples from their training data, a phenomenon known as memorization. Existing memorization detection methods for unconditional diffusion models typically operate at a pre-selected timestep and therefore cannot adapt the detection time to the evolving denoising trajectory. Sequential monitoring enables adaptive detection but repeated testing across timesteps complicates trajectory-level false-alarm control. We study two ways of combining split conformal calibration with sequential monitoring for prompt-free memorization detection: per-step Bonferroni calibration and direct trajectory-level calibration of the maximum memorization score. The former controls repeated testing by splitting the false-alarm budget across timesteps, whereas the latter calibrates the event of ever crossing a threshold directly through the trajectory-level maximum. We evaluate this formulation on an unconditional CIFAR-10 EDM using two complementary per-step statistics based on geometry and representation spikiness. Experiments show that sequential monitoring improves the power-timing tradeoff over fixed-time detection. Compared with Bonferroni calibration, trajectory-level calibration achieves comparable detection power while using the false-alarm budget less conservatively and enabling earlier detection at higher noise levels.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究扩散模型的记忆化早检，将 split conformal 校准与序贯监测结合：比较逐时间步 Bonferroni 分配误报预算与直接对轨迹最大分数做轨迹级校准两种方案，并在 CIFAR-10 无条件 EDM 上用几何与表示尖峰两类逐步统计量评估，发现轨迹级校准在功率相当的情况下可更早、在更高噪声水平上检出。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「沿轨迹序贯监测 + 轨迹级误报控制」的判定框架，可能可供核查 LVR 推理轨迹中何时停止或证据已充分的决策设计；但该统计假设能否迁移到 latent 推理状态仍需较多核查。
